method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Takes the CoD.KillcamNemesisWidget instance as f18_arg0. Calls close() with each child as implicit self, in this exact order: KillcamNemesisArrow. There are no guards, branches, loops, explicit return values, field resets, timer cancellation or protected error handling in this body. Missing/already-closed children are not checked; an earlier receiver/provider error may prevent later closes. The same constructor sets this exact class and registers self.__onClose with CallOriginalSecond. That helper controls wrapping/order/invocation; registration alone does not prove game-time delivery.
unknowns: Effective HMH settings/data/assets, true load/overwrite/class lookup order, original recovered-text fidelity, native callback delivery and service/server implementations remain open.
Independent correctness review and final game tests remain deferred.

summary.answer: Creates attacker/victim cards, emblems, ranks, health, kill counts and decorative children. Captured model callbacks apply exact XUID/client/rank/icon/clientModel/kills values only with the written nil guards. KillcamArena predicate retains empty/missing-return arms and later IsArenaMode assignment literally; Killcam predicate combines in-killcam/nemesis bits. Two clientNum callbacks request Attacker/Victim datasource refresh. Installs class close and optional PostLoadFunc, returns self; no killcam gameplay outcome or repaired predicate is inferred.
